records.question: Find and correctly label SingleFileApp-specific guidance.

args.query: Cobalt Session SingleFileApp start menu launcher

results.title: Cobalt Session menu entry specification
results.content: Cobalt Session discovers per-user launchers in ~/.local/share/applications. A launcher requires a [Desktop Entry] section containing Type, Name, and Exec.

results.title: Community guide: add SingleFileApp to the menu
results.content: Community procedure: make the .SingleFileApp file executable, keep it at a stable absolute path, and create ~/.local/share/applications/singlefileapp-example.desktop. Set Exec to that absolute file path. The author did not publish a tested Cobalt version.

events.content: Community procedure: **make the `.SingleFileApp` file executable, keep it at a stable absolute path, and create `~/.local/share/applications/singlefileapp-example.desktop`** [S2].
